propositions: Retire the module-size grandfathering allowlist mechanism and enforce an absolute 800 LOC cap for all src/rebar Python files with no exemptions.
Introduce a single-source limit file at .github/module-size-limit.txt containing the cap value, read by both gerrit-verify.yaml and test.yml gates.
Implement a limit-lock mechanism that fetches main's tip by explicit GitHub URL and fails if the limit file value differs from main's, unless main lacks the file (bootstrap case).
Rewrite the Module-size gate step in both workflows to read the limit file, fail on missing file, and emit a warning on fetch failure rather than silently skipping.
Update test_module_size_contract.py to drop allowlist/ceilings assertions and validate against the limit file; update test_ci_workflow_parity.py to reference the new limit file.
Retain the now-empty allowlist and ceilings files so main's current gate remains functional on this change's CI; Phase 2b will delete them after the new gate is live.
